'Prevail in both bodily and psychological realms' generalizes exactly this dual-domain claim.

perOption.label: ④

perOption.label: ⑤
perOption.reason: Flat contradiction of the passage's thesis: neglecting proper nutrition is exactly the 'sin' (missing the mark) the passage condemns; conditioning is presented as complementary to, not competing with, practice.

note: Formal check: all five options are bare-infinitive VPs that attach grammatically to 'the strength and stamina to ___ in order to close out their opponents', so the discrimination is purely logical/semantic. Only ② is entailed by the passage's argument structure (physical fitness → advantage in both physical and psychological contests, established via the negotiation example). ① is the strongest distractor but requires an unstated pressure-immunity premise. Single defensible answer; no alternative parse (reduced relative, participial, inversion, etc.) rescues any rejected option.
